scope: Family-level and nearby-composition literature review for Li2Mn_(1-t-n)Ti_tNb_nO2F cathode stoichiometry screening. No exhaustive exact-composition full-text or patent search.
search_queries: Reversible Mn2+ Mn4+ double redox lithium excess
Li Mn Ti Nb oxyfluoride cathodes
high entropy cation disordered rocksalt cathodes
manganese oxyfluoride short range order fluorination
copyright_handling: Full retrieved articles and abstracts are not committed. This file retains bibliographic metadata, paraphrased evidence notes and only very short attributed excerpts.

sources.title: Reversible Mn2+/Mn4+ double redox in lithium-excess cathode materials

retrieved_evidence.kind: OpenAlex metadata connecting repository manuscript with DOI

evidence_summary: Author manuscript lines 62–64 identify Li2Mn2/3Nb1/3O2F and Li2Mn1/2Ti1/2O2F and theoretical Mn2+/Mn4+ capacities about 270 and 230 mAh/g.
Publisher abstract establishes a high-valent-cation and fluorination strategy in disordered-rocksalt Mn cathodes.
Manuscript discusses additional oxygen redox and experimentally characterizes the endpoint materials.
limits: Endpoint specimens do not establish phase formation or performance for other gridpoints.

The author manuscript has the working title Reversible Mn2+/Mn4+ double redox in high capacity Li-excess cathode materials. Its association with the published DOI was verified through the OSTI repository record indexed by OpenAlex.

sources.title: Cation-disordered rocksalt-type high-entropy cathodes for Li-ion batteries
evidence_summary: Author manuscript explicitly gives TM4 as Li1.3Mn(II)0.2Mn(III)0.2Ti0.1Nb0.2O1.7F0.3.
The paper studies how cation short-range order affects lithium transport and electrochemistry.
Nature Materials volume 20 pages 214–221 corresponds to 2021; publication was online 2020-10-12.
limits: TM4 uses different Li/O/F stoichiometry from Li2Mn_(1-t-n)Ti_tNb_nO2F.
No exact-recipe novelty finding follows from this family-level prior art.
More components do not by themselves establish a high-entropy or transport advantage.

sources.title: Toward Better Stability and Reversibility of the Mn 4+ /Mn 2+ Double Redox Activity in Disordered Rocksalt Oxyfluoride Cathode Materials

retrieved_evidence.kind: OpenAlex indexed abstract and publication metadata

evidence_summary: OpenAlex indexed abstract describes Li2Mn_(1-x)Ti_xO2F for 0 <= x <= 2/3.
The indexed abstract reports Ti3+ and oxygen oxidation in Ti-rich compositions.
limits: Only indexed abstract and bibliographic metadata were retrieved; full text was not verified.
Fixed Ti4+ spectator behavior is a declared model assumption, not established for all Ti-rich compositions.

sources.title: Effect of Fluorination on Lithium Transport and Short‐Range Order in Disordered‐Rocksalt‐Type Lithium‐Ion Battery Cathodes
evidence_summary: Crossref deposited abstract describes DFT and Monte Carlo modeling of Li-F short-range ordering, lithium percolation and diffusion.
Abstract discusses tradeoffs among transition-metal capacity, lithium transport and synthetic accessibility.
limits: Evidence reviewed is a deposited abstract, not a new simulation of these recipes.
Charge balance and fixed lithium fraction do not establish diffusion pathways or usable capacity.

sources.title: Redox Chemistry and the Role of Trapped Molecular O2 in Li-Rich Disordered Rocksalt Oxyfluoride Cathodes
sources.publication: Journal of the American Chemical Society
evidence_summary: Crossref deposited abstract discusses Li2MnO2F, trapped molecular O2 formed during oxygen redox and overlap with Mn redox.
The abstract describes Mn3+/Mn4+ redox without evidence of Mn5+ or Mn7+ in that studied material.
limits: Li2MnO2F is a comparator, not proof of the mechanism or reversibility of oxygen redox in other formulas.
Mn-only bookkeeping is not a total-capacity ceiling when oxygen redox participates.

sources.title: Redox Chemistry of a Lithium-Excess Disordered-Rocksalt Oxyfluoride Cathode: Li 2 Mn 0.625 Nb 0.375 O 2 F
evidence_summary: Crossref DOI/title/date metadata identifies Li2Mn0.625Nb0.375O2F and publication date 2026-06-08.
limits: Only title and bibliographic metadata are used as verified evidence here; no performance or mechanism claim is taken from the article.

Under the screen fixed species charges the title formula implies average Mn +1.8, outside the declared +2 to +3 screen. That is a model bookkeeping observation, not an experimental valence determination.
